# Preface {.unnumbered}

Transcription of the WWII journals of Richard Pomeroy, three typewritten volumes (364 pages), and the reproducible R pipeline used to produce it.

The source scans are kept as a local copy only. This book documents the pipeline and publishes the resulting transcription.

Downloads of the transcription (DOCX, searchable PDF, and per-page CSV) are linked in [Assembly](08-assembly.qmd).
